sub_graphs.title: Prague Transactions: Transaction Type Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models the different transaction types and their specific handling paths

nodes.label: Raw Transaction Bytes Received
nodes.description: Transaction bytes have been received for decoding

nodes.label: Decode Transaction
nodes.description: Inspects first byte to determine transaction type and decode accordingly

nodes.label: Legacy Transaction Detected
nodes.description: Transaction is a legacy type (no type prefix, RLP-encoded directly)

nodes.label: Access List Transaction Detected
nodes.description: Transaction has type prefix 0x01 (EIP-2930)

nodes.label: Fee Market Transaction Detected
nodes.description: Transaction has type prefix 0x02 (EIP-1559)

nodes.label: Blob Transaction Detected
nodes.description: Transaction has type prefix 0x03 (EIP-4844)

nodes.label: SetCode Transaction Detected
nodes.description: Transaction has type prefix 0x04 (EIP-7702)

nodes.label: Decode Legacy Format
nodes.description: RLP decode legacy transaction with nonce, gas_price, gas, to, value, data, v, r, s

nodes.label: Decode Typed Transaction
nodes.description: Strip type byte and RLP decode remaining payload

nodes.label: Transaction Decoded
nodes.description: Transaction structure has been successfully parsed

external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
external_entities.description: External entity submitting raw transaction bytes

sub_graphs.title: Prague Transactions: Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the transaction validation checks and error conditions

nodes.label: Transaction Pending Validation
nodes.description: Decoded transaction ready for validation checks

nodes.label: Calculate Intrinsic Gas Cost
nodes.description: Computes base cost (21000) + calldata + create cost + access list + auth costs

nodes.label: Calculate Calldata Floor Cost
nodes.description: Computes EIP-7623 floor: (zero_bytes + non_zero_bytes*4) * 10 + 21000

nodes.label: Check Gas Sufficiency
nodes.description: Validates tx.gas >= max(intrinsic_cost, floor_cost)

nodes.label: Check Nonce Overflow
nodes.description: Validates nonce < 2^64 - 1 per EIP-2681

nodes.label: Check Init Code Size
nodes.description: For contract creation, validates init code <= MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE

nodes.label: Transaction Validation Passed
nodes.description: Transaction has passed all validate_transaction checks

nodes.label: Transaction Rejected: Insufficient Gas
nodes.description: Transaction gas less than intrinsic or floor cost

nodes.label: Transaction Rejected: Nonce Overflow
nodes.description: Transaction nonce >= 2^64 - 1

nodes.label: Transaction Rejected: Init Code Too Large
nodes.description: Contract creation init code exceeds MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE

sub_graphs.title: Prague Transactions: Signature Recovery
sub_graphs.description: Models the ECDSA signature validation and sender address recovery

nodes.label: Transaction Awaiting Signature Verification
nodes.description: Transaction needs signature validation and sender recovery

nodes.label: Validate R Component Range
nodes.description: Checks 0 < r < SECP256K1N

nodes.label: Validate S Component Range
nodes.description: Checks 0 < s <= SECP256K1N / 2 (low-s requirement)

nodes.label: Compute Signing Hash
nodes.description: Computes keccak256 of transaction data per type-specific format

nodes.label: Compute Pre-EIP155 Hash
nodes.description: Hash without chain_id for v in {27, 28}

nodes.label: Compute EIP-155 Hash
nodes.description: Hash includes chain_id for replay protection

nodes.label: Compute Typed Transaction Hash
nodes.description: Hash with type prefix (0x01, 0x02, 0x03, or 0x04)

nodes.label: Recover Public Key
nodes.description: Uses secp256k1_recover to derive public key from signature

nodes.label: Derive Sender Address
nodes.description: Takes keccak256 of public key, extracts rightmost 20 bytes

nodes.label: Sender Address Recovered
nodes.description: Valid sender address has been determined from signature

nodes.label: Invalid Signature Rejected
nodes.description: Signature validation failed

external_entities.name: Transaction Signer
external_entities.description: Entity holding private key that signed the transaction

sub_graphs.title: Prague Transactions: Intrinsic Gas Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the detailed intrinsic gas cost calculation for different transaction types

nodes.label: Transaction Needs Gas Calculation
nodes.description: Transaction ready for intrinsic cost calculation

nodes.label: Add Base Transaction Cost
nodes.description: Adds TX_BASE_COST (21000 gas units)

nodes.label: Calculate Calldata Cost
nodes.description: Adds 4 gas per non-zero byte, 0 gas per zero byte

nodes.label: Check Contract Creation
nodes.description: Determines if to field is empty (contract creation)

nodes.label: Add Contract Creation Cost
nodes.description: Adds TX_CREATE_COST (32000) + init code size cost

nodes.label: Calculate Access List Cost
nodes.description: Adds 2400 per address + 1900 per storage slot

nodes.label: Calculate Authorization Cost
nodes.description: For SetCodeTransaction: adds per-empty-account cost per authorization

nodes.label: Intrinsic Gas Computed
nodes.description: Total intrinsic gas cost has been calculated

nodes.label: Calculate EIP-7623 Floor Gas
nodes.description: Computes floor_cost = (total_tokens * FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST) + TX_BASE_COST

nodes.label: Gas Requirements Determined
nodes.description: Both intrinsic cost and floor cost are known

ambiguities.text: The STANDARD_CALLDATA_TOKEN_COST constant (4 gas) is mentioned but the definition of 'token' in calldata context is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'token' refers to a single byte of calldata, with zero bytes costing 0 gas and non-zero bytes costing 4 gas.

ambiguities.text: The authorization cost calculation for SetCodeTransaction references 'per-empty-account cost' without specifying the exact amount
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume authorization cost follows EIP-7702 specification which defines costs for new vs existing accounts in authorization list.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'low-s requirement' for signature validation is referenced without explicit justification
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this refers to BIP-62 malleability fix requiring s <= SECP256K1N/2 to prevent signature malleability attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: RLP decoding is assumed to correctly reject malformed transaction data
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malformed transactions could cause parsing errors or incorrect field extraction

implicit_assumptions.description: The SECP256K1N constant and secp256k1 curve parameters are correctly implemented
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Signature validation could accept invalid signatures or reject valid ones

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot perform signature malleability attacks due to low-s enforcement
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Transaction uniqueness could be compromised, affecting transaction tracking and replay protection

implicit_assumptions.description: MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE is sufficient for legitimate contract deployments while preventing DoS
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Either legitimate contracts cannot be deployed, or attackers can deploy extremely large init code
